build_SubwordNMTBPE: build a SubwordNMTBPE instance from a config with bpe_codes path and separator settings
encode_SubwordNMTBPE_encode: encode a text string into BPE subword tokens using the SubwordNMTBPE encode method
decode_SubwordNMTBPE_decode: decode BPE subword tokens back into original text using the SubwordNMTBPE decode method
review_SubwordNMTBPEConfig: review the SubwordNMTBPEConfig dataclass to understand bpe_codes and bpe_separator configuration fields
test_SubwordNMTBPE_roundtrip: test encoding then decoding text through SubwordNMTBPE to verify roundtrip correctness
